15-SEC CINEMATIC VIDEO PROMPT • 16:9
CHARACTER (Locked)

Jessy — Soft round face, nude-pink lips, hazel-green eyes, thick lashes, small gold nose ring, warm skin. Honey-brown hair with steel-blue face-framing streaks in a high messy ponytail with loose strands. White ribbed crop top, black wide-leg track pants with white side stripe, white low-top sneakers, thin gold chain, small gold hoops.

SETTING

Golden-hour rooftop futsal court overlooking the city. Concrete surface with faded court lines, portable goals, warm amber sunlight, long shadows, drifting chalk dust, energetic teenage match in progress.

0:00–0:01 — ARRIVAL

Wide establishing shot. Jessy steps onto the rooftop from the stairwell, shielding her eyes as the game continues. Golden skyline behind.

0:01–0:02 — BALL ROLLS IN

Low tracking shot. A missed shot sends the ball rolling perfectly to her feet. She looks down.

0:02–0:03 — THE INVITE

Close-up. A smiling player waves her onto the court.

0:03–0:04 — CONFIDENT SMIRK

Close-up. Jessy smirks, tucks a blue hair strand behind her ear, eyes locked on the game.

0:04–0:05 — GAME ON

Medium shot. She casually rolls her pant hems, places one foot on the ball, rolls it twice, then steps forward.

0:05–0:07 — FIRST MOVES

Ground-level tracking. Smooth first touch, quick dribble, effortless body feint past the first defender.

0:07–0:09 — SKILL SHOW

Low tracking shot. Clean nutmeg through the second defender, followed immediately by a sharp drag-back spin past a third.

0:09–0:10.5 — RAINBOW FLICK

Side tracking shot. Jessy performs a perfect rainbow flick over the final defender. Ball catches the golden sunlight as the crowd erupts.

0:10.5–0:12 — THE STRIKE

Slow-motion hero shot from behind. She unleashes a powerful right-foot strike. Chalk dust explodes beneath her planted foot, ponytail whipping through the light.

0:12–0:13.5 — BALL FLIGHT

Ball POV toward goal. Goalkeeper dives at full stretch but can't reach it.

0:13.5–0:15 — GOAL & CELEBRATION

Extreme close-up as the ball smashes into the top corner. Wide orbiting shot of teenagers rushing onto the court, celebrating around Jessy under glowing golden-hour light as the city skyline shines behind. Fade out.

골을 향한 공의 시점. 골키퍼가 전력을 다해 다이빙하지만 닿지 못한다.
